ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Process By Web Server Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potentially suspicious processes being spawned by a web server process which could be the result of a successfully placed web shell or exploitation

RGX("\\\\php\\-cgi\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\php\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\tomcat\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\UMWorkerProcess\\\.exe$") OR
